'''Darga's organization''' was a criminal organization led by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Darga Jiramma Mionne]] and based in his [[Darga the Hutt's palace|palace]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], it became involved with [[Sarlacc Project]], when it made a deal with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to supply [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna gas]] for the project, in return for [[Nazren]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].
